Definition
[Holonomy deformation equivalence] \group deformation theorySource: thurston:page-0097 For a compact $(G,X)$--manifold $M$, two nearby structures are equivalent when, after deleting small neighborhoods of their boundaries, a near-identity $(G,X)$--homeomorphism identifies them. The developing map determines a holonomy representation $\pi _1M\to G$.
